dictionaryPlayContextCandidates.meaning: 大雪で道路・配達・郵便などが止まり、Monkswell Manorが外界から物理的に孤立すること。場面全体の重要な転換点。/雪で道路が遮断され、さらに電話も使えなくなり、外部との移動・通信の両方が断たれた状態。
英語圏の伝承童謡『Three Blind Mice』の題名。
Culver Streetと違いMonkswell Manorには、次の標的になり得る人物が複数いるという意味。
Three Blind Miceの旋律が頭から離れず繰り返し浮かぶ、という意味。殺人と結びついたため不穏な含みを持つ。
Longridge Farm事件について少しでも自分に責任・後ろめたさがある者は、それを認めるべきだという意味。

【固有名詞】
劇中で住所の受取先として名が挙がる銀行名。実在の特定機関とは断定しない。

【固有名詞】
劇中で宿泊先として名が挙がるホテル。実在施設の同定はしない。

【固有名詞】
劇中のLongridge Farmの思い出で言及される犬の名前。
【固有名詞】Monkswell Manor Guest House。本作でMollieとGilesが営む宿泊施設名。
【固有名詞】Major Metcalfという人名・呼称。Majorは軍の階級名。
【固有名詞】Miss Casewellという人名・呼称。
【固有名詞】Sergeant Trotterという人名・呼称。Sergeantは軍・警察などの階級名。

cut off.speaker: PARAVICINI
cut off.text: Yes ― the unexpected guest. The guest that you did not invite. The guest who just arrived ― from nowhere ― out of the storm. It sounds quite dramatic, does it not? Who am I? You do not know. Where do I come from? You do not know. Me, I am the man of mystery. But now, I tell you this. I complete the picture. From now on there will be no more arrivals. And no departures either. By tomorrow ― perhaps even already ― we are cut off from civilization. No butcher, no baker, no milkman, no postman, no daily papers ― nobody and nothing but ourselves. That is admirable ― admirable. It could not suit me better. My name, by the way, is Paravicini. Mr. and Mrs. Ralston? And this ― is Monkswell Manor Guest House, you said? Good. Monkswell Manor Guest House. Perfect. Perfect.

cut off.speaker: PARAVICINI
cut off.text: Yes ― the unexpected guest. The guest that you did not invite. The guest who just arrived ― from nowhere ― out of the storm. It sounds quite dramatic, does it not? Who am I? You do not know. Where do I come from? You do not know. Me, I am the man of mystery. But now, I tell you this. I complete the picture. From now on there will be no more arrivals. And no departures either. By tomorrow ― perhaps even already ― we are cut off from civilization. No butcher, no baker, no milkman, no postman, no daily papers ― nobody and nothing but ourselves. That is admirable ― admirable. It could not suit me better. My name, by the way, is Paravicini. Mr. and Mrs. Ralston? And this ― is Monkswell Manor Guest House, you said? Good. Monkswell Manor Guest House. Perfect. Perfect.

cut off.speaker: CHRISTOPHER
cut off.text: So we're quite cut off now. Quite cut off. That's funny, isn't it?

cut off.speaker: PARAVICINI
cut off.text: But such a gay little tune? Don't you think? She cut off their tails with a carving knife ― snick, snick, snick ― delicious. Just what a child would adore. Cruel little things, children. Some of them never grow up.

Three Blind Mice.speaker: TROTTER
Three Blind Mice.text: Yes, Mrs. Ralston. Below the two addresses was written "Three Blind Mice." And on the dead woman's body was a paper with "This is the First" written on it, and below the words, a drawing of three little mice and a bar of music. The music was the tune of the nursery rhyme Three Blind Mice. You know how it goes. "Three Blind Mice..."

Three Blind Mice.speaker: TROTTER
Three Blind Mice.inThisPlay: この箇所では、事件の反復モチーフになっている童謡の題名。歌詞そのものではなく、題名・旋律への言及。
Three Blind Mice.text: Who was whistling Three Blind Mice? Are you making this up, Mr. Paravicini?

wider field.speaker: TROTTER
wider field.text: Because there were only two addresses in the notebook we found. Now, at twenty-four Culver Street there was only one possible victim. She's dead. But here at Monkswell Manor there is a wider field.

run in someone's head.speaker: PARAVICINI
run in someone's head.text: And yet ― it runs in people's head. Someone was whistling it, too.

Morgan's Bank.speaker: MISS CASEWELL
Morgan's Bank.inThisPlay: Casewellが英国での連絡先を「Morgan’s Bank気付」と答える。
Morgan's Bank.text: Care of Morgan's Bank, Leadenhall Street.

Ledbury Hotel.speaker: MISS CASEWELL
Ledbury Hotel.inThisPlay: Casewellがイングランド到着後の宿泊先として答える名称。

Monkswell Manor Guest House.speaker: GILES
Monkswell Manor Guest House.inThisPlay: MollieとGilesが始めたゲストハウスの名称。
Monkswell Manor Guest House.text: This is Monkswell Manor Guest House.

Monkswell Manor Guest House.speaker: PARAVICINI
Monkswell Manor Guest House.inThisPlay: MollieとGilesが始めたゲストハウスの名称。
Monkswell Manor Guest House.text: Yes ― the unexpected guest. The guest that you did not invite. The guest who just arrived ― from nowhere ― out of the storm. It sounds quite dramatic, does it not? Who am I? You do not know. Where do I come from? You do not know. Me, I am the man of mystery. But now, I tell you this. I complete the picture. From now on there will be no more arrivals. And no departures either. By tomorrow ― perhaps even already ― we are cut off from civilization. No butcher, no baker, no milkman, no postman, no daily papers ― nobody and nothing but ourselves. That is admirable ― admirable. It could not suit me better. My name, by the way, is Paravicini. Mr. and Mrs. Ralston? And this ― is Monkswell Manor Guest House, you said? Good. Monkswell Manor Guest House. Perfect. Perfect.

Monkswell Manor Guest House.speaker: MOLLIE
Monkswell Manor Guest House.inThisPlay: MollieとGilesが始めたゲストハウスの名称。
Monkswell Manor Guest House.text: Yes? Yes ― this is Monkswell Manor Guest House...What?...No, I'm afraid Mr. Ralston can't come to the telephone just now. This is Mrs. Ralston speaking. Who...? The Berkshire Police...? Oh yes, yes, Superintendent Hogben, I'm afraid that's impossible. He'd never get here. We're snowed up. Completely snowed up. The roads are impassable... Nothing can get through...Yes...Very well...But what... Hullo-hullo...

Major Metcalf.speaker: MOLLIE
Major Metcalf.inThisPlay: Monkswell Manorの宿泊客で、Majorの軍階級で呼ばれる人物。
Major Metcalf.text: Yes. Mrs. Boyle, Front Fourposter Room. Major Metcalf, Blue Room. Miss Casewell, East Room. Mr. Wren, Oak Room.

Major Metcalf.speaker: MOLLIE
Major Metcalf.inThisPlay: Monkswell Manorの宿泊客で、Majorの軍階級で呼ばれる人物。
Major Metcalf.text: No ― I put Mr. Wren in the Rose Room. He liked the fourposter so much. So it's Mrs. Boyle in the Oak Room and Major Metcalf in the Blue Room.

Major Metcalf.speaker: MRS. BOYLE
Major Metcalf.inThisPlay: Monkswell Manorの宿泊客で、Majorの軍階級で呼ばれる人物。
Major Metcalf.text: I would have said that a proper staff of servants was essential before opening this kind of establishment. I consider your advertisement was most misleading. May I ask if I am the only guest ― with Major Metcalf, that is?

Major Metcalf.speaker: MOLLIE
Major Metcalf.inThisPlay: Monkswell Manorの宿泊客で、Majorの軍階級で呼ばれる人物。
Major Metcalf.text: I must hurry out to the kitchen and get on with things. Major Metcalf is very nice. He won't be difficult. It's Mrs. Boyle really frightens me. We must have a nice dinner. I was thinking of opening two tins of minced beef and cereal and a tin of peas, and mashing the potatoes. And there's stewed figs and custard. Do you think that will be all right?

Major Metcalf.speaker: MOLLIE
Major Metcalf.inThisPlay: Monkswell Manorの宿泊客で、Majorの軍階級で呼ばれる人物。
Major Metcalf.text: It seems very hard that all our guests should be either unpleasant or odd. Anyway, I think Major Metcalf's all right, don't you?

Major Metcalf.speaker: MOLLIE
Major Metcalf.inThisPlay: Monkswell Manorの宿泊客で、Majorの軍階級で呼ばれる人物。
Major Metcalf.text: There's Mrs. Boyle and Major Metcalf and Miss Casewell and a young man called Christopher Wren ― and now ― you.

Miss Casewell.speaker: MOLLIE
Miss Casewell.text: Yes. Mrs. Boyle, Front Fourposter Room. Major Metcalf, Blue Room. Miss Casewell, East Room. Mr. Wren, Oak Room.

Miss Casewell.speaker: GILES
Miss Casewell.text: Here's Miss Casewell, Mollie. My wife.

Miss Casewell.speaker: MOLLIE
Miss Casewell.text: I don't believe it. I like him. I think Miss Casewell's rather peculiar, don't you?

Miss Casewell.speaker: MOLLIE
Miss Casewell.text: There's Mrs. Boyle and Major Metcalf and Miss Casewell and a young man called Christopher Wren ― and now ― you.

Sergeant Trotter.speaker: MOLLIE
Sergeant Trotter.inThisPlay: 警察のSergeantとして派遣される人物。ここではMollieが電話で名前を聞き取っている。
Sergeant Trotter.text: That's what I asked. But he wouldn't say. Just said I was to impress on my husband to listen very carefully to what Sergeant Trotter, I think it was, had to say, and to follow his instructions implicitly. Isn't it extraordinary?
